method.pace_adjustment: Each metric is allowed-per-opportunity rescaled to league-average opportunities per game. Raw per-game allowed correlates +0.568 with pass attempts faced, so it partly measures pace rather than defence. Unadjusted values are retained under *_unadjusted for comparison.
method.signal_caveat: Residual test 2022-2025: does the defence faced explain production above the player's own average? QB 0.124, RB 0.097, TE 0.083 are consistently positive across four seasons. WR is 0.034 and went negative in 2024 despite the largest sample (~857 player-games per season). Weight QB/RB/TE matchups above WR; all effects are weak.
method.rank_direction: rank 1 = most vulnerable = best matchup for the player
